label: HOME top (390px): hero + trust billboard + tiles + nav pill
verdict:

BRAND-COLOR: Yes — warm cream page background, white cards, and bright aqua/teal accents (search icon, tile icons, live chip) are clearly present.
PHOTOGRAPHY: Yes — real doctor portraits render (Rajesh and the partially visible next card) rather than gray initials circles.
LIFE/DELIGHT: Feels alive — pulsing "live" chip, ink stats billboard, photos, and soft card shadows give the page warmth.
HERO: Yes — "Namaste" greeting, Ahmedabad city pill, glass-style search bar, and symptom chips (fever, knee pain, skin, child, acidity) all present and legible.
BILLBOARD: Yes — dark ink band with big bold numbers 97/13/71 and readable sub-labels.
TILES: Yes — two entry tiles with aqua line icons (stethoscope, lab tubes), no photography.
LABS: FAIL on this evidence — the lab section is cut off at the screen bottom; no three lab cards with "from ₹" prices or dated caption are visible in the provided shots.

NITPICKS:
1. Hospital card metadata row ("2 doctors · departments") partially hidden behind the floating nav pill — add bottom padding/scroll clearance — major.
2. Lab tests section is cut off mid-banner at the viewport bottom, with the dark banner text ("Lab tests at home…") clipped — minor.
3. Horizontal scroll rows (symptom chips, doctor cards) show hard edge-cut items ("acidity", second doctor card) without fade-out affordance — minor.
